# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Fills and status backgrounds — 5 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 18 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 10 tokens; Radius — 1 token; Layout — 6 tokens; Duration — 4 tokens; Easing — 1 token.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the core theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #f7f5f2);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="ct-lab" or "collision-lab" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #f7f5f2);   /* the ct-lab theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f7f5f2;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | core | ct-lab | collision-lab | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #f7f5f2 | #f7f5f2 | #f7f5f2 | Off-white paper (assets/styles.css :root). Default light canvas; text on `ink` (16.75:1) and on `purple-deep` (12.63:1). |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the core theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--accent-paper, #6d23c8);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="ct-lab" or "collision-lab" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from that theme’s column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--accent-paper, #9d006c);   /* the ct-lab theme’s value */
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #6d23c8;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | core | ct-lab | collision-lab | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--accent-paper` | #6d23c8 | #9d006c | #6d23c8 | The expression's accent on a paper surface (`data-surface="paper"`): eyebrows, meta, text actions, nav underline, focus ring, selected fills. Core and Collision Lab `purple` 7.08:1 on `paper`; CT LAB `lab-magenta-on-light` 7.28:1. Text on its fill: `on-accent-paper`. |
| `--accent-ink` | #cfaff4 | #ff38d1 | #b86cff | The expression's accent on an ink surface (`data-surface="ink"`): core `violet-on-dark` 9.63:1 on `ink`, CT LAB `lab-magenta` 5.85:1, Collision Lab `collision-violet` 5.75:1. Text on its fill: `on-accent-ink`. |
| `--accent-ink-inverse` | #cfaff4 | #ff93e5 | #b86cff | The accent on a paper tile that has inverted to ink on hover or focus: CT LAB uses its hover magenta `lab-magenta-hover` (9.16:1 on `ink`, ct-lab/index.html .track:hover); core and Collision Lab keep their ink accent. |
| `--on-accent-paper` | #ffffff | #ffffff | #ffffff | Text on an accent fill on a paper surface: `white` on `purple` 7.71:1, on `lab-magenta-on-light` 7.92:1. |
| `--on-accent-ink` | #17141b | #17141b | #17141b | Text on an accent fill on an ink surface: `ink` on `violet-on-dark` 9.63:1, on `lab-magenta` 5.85:1, on `collision-violet` 5.75:1. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 10.9rem/0.83 "Glacial Indifference", "Avenir Next", "Century Gothic", "Trebuchet MS", sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.066em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.066em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Font availability

The canonical CSS requests `"Glacial Indifference"` as the display face but does **not** bundle font binaries. Use the font already licensed and hosted by the main website or a locally installed copy. Offline standalone previews use the fallback font stack when Glacial Indifference is unavailable; this is degraded typography, not the preferred brand state. Inter is optional and falls back to the system sans.
